purpose: Give one consequential decision a serious structured challenge before action is taken.

story.origin_narrative: Brand positioning story, not a claim about company founding history. The loudest answer is not always the wisest one. The Chamber exists for moments when assumptions deserve cross-examination and disagreement has useful work to do.
story.core_belief: A better decision survives better questions.

signature_phrase: Bring the decision. We'll challenge the assumptions.

personality.tone: measured, composed, intellectually brave; elegant and restrained
principles: Not a corporate board of directors
No claim of live autonomous multi-model debate

design_system.typography: heritage serif headlines, spare humanist sans body
design_system.motif: architectural columns, fine brass rules and deliberate negative space

relationship.parent_visibility: Small endorsement after the individual product story; never replace product identity
relationship.payment: Original exact-price Systemia Stripe checkout only; no rebranding of Stripe product without separate approval

governance.visual_identity_direction: Custom CSS motif; not a registered logo or legal mark

assets.usage: Emblem and palette are original working design directions. Not trademark cleared and not proof of external publication.
